steps.title: Masuk Windows Recovery via Bootable USB
steps.commandOrAction: Colok flashdisk bootable, nyalakan PC tekan F12/F8 pilih USB, masuk Repair your computer -> Troubleshoot -> Advanced Options -> Command Prompt

steps.title: Eksekusi Rekonstruksi MBR & BCD
steps.commandOrAction:
Ketik di CMD berturut-turut:
1. `bootrec /fixmbr` (Enter)
2. `bootrec /fixboot` (Enter)
3. `bootrec /rebuildbcd` (Enter)
Jika muncul 'Add installation to boot list?', tekan `Y` lalu Enter.

steps.title: Verifikasi Partisi Aktif via Diskpart (Jika BCD gagal)
steps.commandOrAction: Ketik `diskpart` -> `list disk` -> `select disk 0` -> `list partition` -> cek partisi System Reserved/EFI

steps.title: Reboot & Testing Boot Normal
steps.commandOrAction: Cabut flashdisk, ketik `exit`, lalu klik 'Continue to Windows 10/11'
